headline: US Government Repeatedly Pressed Musk Over Starlink Satellite Access
summary: US officials repeatedly asked Elon Musk to modify, expand, or restrict access to SpaceX's Starlink satellite internet network in conflict and sensitive zones, Reuters reported.
why: Starlink has become critical communications infrastructure in geopolitical flashpoints, drawing intense regulatory and defense scrutiny.

impacts.name: Satellite Communications
impacts.why: Government operational requests highlight both defense reliance on and regulatory exposure of commercial satellite networks.
